name: Proprietary Custodian-Data Platform -- feasibility + build to replace Black Diamond + Orion
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-23: assess feasibility for (and then build) a proprietary data platform that owns the custodian-aggregation layer ourselves, displacing the Black Diamond + Orion middle tier we currently pay for + integrate against. Thesis (Andrew): BD/Orion just take custodian data + wrap it in UI; we already aggregate custodian data (BD for 49F+Cottonwood, Orion for Inflection, Schwab direct for 49F) + serve it (ADVI portal + MDPF model-feed), and the 3 firms already converge on ONE served contract (platinum/firm/*.json + the ADVI endpoint). So 'replace BD/Orion' = promote the aggregation layer we already operate from a per-firm patchwork into a first-class proprietary platform + go direct-to-custodian where the aggregator adds only UI. New macro DATA stood up to isolate this large research+execution program. PHASE 0 = research/scoping (the PRD frames + scopes the audit); Phase 1 = the broad+deep audit (D1-D6 specs); Phase 2 = the unified data-shape/bucketing architecture; Phase 3 = the MDPF/ADVI input archetype. Likely SmartX partnership for the custodian-aggregation + performance-SoR + model/trade (Eclipse-class) layer. Existing methodologies assessed: 49F (BD, overfit/lots-FIFO), Cottonwood (cot, nascent fork), Inflection (Orion, best-shape snapshot -- the reference). Grounded against a 5-surface live-repo sweep (Schwab/BD/Orion+Eclipse/SmartX/existing-firm-methodologies).
